hooks.name: Workflow and Lint Config Check on Save
hooks.description: Runs actionlint on saved GitHub Actions workflows and yamllint -c .yamllint on the saved file. A broken workflow or lint config is otherwise only discovered on push. The matcher covers .github/workflows/*.yml, .github/dependabot.yml, .yamllint, and .golangci.yml; v1 does not substitute ${file}, so the script resolves its target from the STDIN payload and falls back to the git-dirty set.
